name: postdovo
description: Plan, write, schedule and publish social media posts from your agent, on the social accounts you connected in your PostDovo account.
suggestedPrompts: Which social accounts do I have connected in PostDovo?
Write a LinkedIn post about our new opening hours and save it as a draft in PostDovo.
Make three Facebook posts for tomorrow, one for the morning, one for lunch and one for the evening, and schedule them in PostDovo.
